hardCaps.publicInvariant: Firmware versions, digests, sizes and download paths are exact immutable authority.
A Campaign freezes every target and Upgrade Plan atomically or creates nothing.
A Device has at most one active Update and one current Command.
Report sequence, command identity, token and exact replay produce at most one effect.
Only the current exact VERIFY digest and token may change installed firmware.
Failure, timeout and cancellation converge on one rollback to captured prior firmware.
Expired Command Work is recoverable and stale lease owners cannot commit.
Migration preserves commands, tokens, reports, versions, events and saved replay identity.
